title: Dislike of progressive jazz and rock and roll
summary: He does not like progressive jazz or rock and roll and prefers western music, which he played for dancers.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: No. Well, progressive, I don't like progressive. And they rock and roll. Because I feel, I feel, I used to feel a lot of western songs, when I was playing for dancers, you know. So, boy, they, you know, they came in. I don't like that, I don't understand it, that's why.
